preserve: O9 explicit memory advantage; GRU/slot negatives
research_question: Does a learned, observation-and-action-conditioned two-state transition operator form reusable causal memory across long action compositions, versus an equally trained action-ablated operator, GRU, public fitted history models and a labeled hand-engineered public-information witness?
source_seed_sha256: SHA256 of UTF8 source_seed_prefix:role:family:index, take first 8 big-endian bytes -> Python Random

families.A_PARITY_COMPOSITION: At time0 public observation is random cue. All pre-query actions uniformly 0/1 and observations iid public distractors. Query action=2; next public target = initial cue XOR parity of observed prior action1 with independent .05 flip.
families.B_OBSERVATION_WRITE_TOGGLE: At time0 public observation random cue and memory starts equal cue. At each pre-query timestep action0 writes current PUBLIC observation to memory, action1 toggles current memory. Query action2: target memory with independent .05 flip. All nonquery next public observations iid fair distractors.
families.NULL_IID: Same public cue, actions, query positions, observation schedule; query next bit independent uniform Bernoulli.

public_input: At t learner observes o_t∈{0,1}, a_t∈{0,1,2}, first-event flag. Must predict query response before observing it. No family identity, hidden memory, future bit or target as model input. Only query result supervises training.

arms.LEARNED_MARKOV_OPERATOR: Two-state differentiable belief, initial sigmoid(b+w*cue), four independently learnable public (action,observation) conditional transition matrices with 2 Bernoulli logits each, sigmoid query decoder. Exactly 12 trainable parameters, query-only analytic BPTT, Adam 24 epochs, seed17/31, choose only by PUBLIC_SELECT.
arms.ACTION_TIED_OPERATOR: Same belief and decoder but contexts tied over actions; two observation-conditional transition matrices with 2 Bernoulli logits each, 8 trainable parameters, identical training budgets and inputs. Critical action-dependence ablation.
arms.ERASED_MARKOV_OPERATOR: Same selected fitted LEARNED_MARKOV_OPERATOR, belief reset to 0.5 directly before query prediction, no retraining. Diagnostic state-erasure.
arms.O9_GRU_2: Exact copied prior O9 trainable memory source; 2-cell GRU, 57 parameters, 12 epochs Adam 0.01, seed17/31 select only fresh O10_PUBLIC_SELECT.
arms.FITTED_PUBLIC_HISTORY_COUNTS: Laplace+1 counts over cue, parity of PUBLIC action1, current public observation, most-recent nonquery action; 16 contexts; fitted same PUBLIC_TRAIN.
arms.PUBLIC_HISTORY_LOGISTIC: Logistic fitted PUBLIC_TRAIN only: cue, parity of public action1, last public observation, last action, cue*parity, query delay bucket plus bias. Full batch gradient 50 epochs lr0.3, L2=0.001.
arms.CURRENT_QUERY_COUNTS: Laplace+1 fitted counts over public current observation and query delay bucket; 4 contexts.
arms.ENGINEERED_PUBLIC_PROGRAM_WITNESS: Public program follows source-family mathematical rule using only public action/observation history, fits Laplace+1 Bernoulli count on its computed memory state, and is explicitly labeled privileged *mechanism-engineered information sufficiency diagnostic*, never equal-architecture conventional comparison.

train.selection: minimum PUBLIC_SELECT query NLL within each arm, no family cross selection on PUBLIC_DEV; no post-DEV tuning
train.model_parameters: learned 12; action-tied 8; independent O9 GRU 57; other sizes emitted

initialization: Each operator Bernoulli transition logit uniformly in [-1.8,1.8], initial and decoder weights uniform [-0.6,0.6]; no rule-seeded initial parameters.
metrics: signed gain vs strongest FULLY TRAINED non-oracle arm
signed gain vs action-tied ablation and state-erasure
finite-difference analytic gradient check on PUBLIC_TRAIN episode only
full per-arm trained checkpoint hash, parameters and serialized bytes
per-arm training+selection CPU and DEV inference CPU
overall CPU and process memory RSS/tracemalloc
exact Linux/Windows cross-OS source and score reconciliation
negative_stopping: If action-conditioned operator does not beat trained GRU and conventional public-history models on BOTH composition families or ablation does not support learned state, retain no-go. Do not optimize O10 after inspecting DEV.
controls: All arms see same public history. Program witness is deliberately hand-engineered and may use known source-family transition semantics; NOT an equally learned competitor. Trained public-history controls have hand-engineered features; disclose differences. No proven nontransformer cognition from toy families.
cross_os: 9 family/role SHA256 source hashes exactly match and 3x9 arm query NLL values match <=1e-6.
guardrails: No protected Q20/Q21/Q21N01 roles, HELD originals, FSA admission or CKB-plane dispatch.
No mutations of O2-O9 research artifacts or previous DEV outcomes.
No controller, new scheduler, KTRADE, broker, Cloudflare write or paid API.
GitHub-hosted source-only runners, draft unmerged until full regression.
No claim of unfamiliar independent-source transfer.
